senses.gloss:
मोटक मोटक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. मुट्),
a globule, pill; मोटकं नेत्र-रोगाणाम्, a pill to
be used as a remedy against ophthalmia; (अस्), m.,
N. of an author; (ई), f., N. of a Rāgiṇī; (अम्), n.
a broken or crushed leaf.

मोटन, अस्, ई, अम्, crushing, pressing, rubbing,
grinding, tearing, destroying [cf. गज-म्˚]; (अस्),
m. wind, air; (अम्), n. the act of crushing, breaking,
grinding, strangling, (गल-मोटन, wringing the
neck); [cf. अङ्गुलि-म्˚.]

मोटनक, अम्, n. crushing, entire destruction;
a kind of metre, four times ¯¯˘˘¯˘˘¯˘˘¯.
मोटि मोटि in कर्ण-म्˚, q. v.

मोट्टायित मोट्टायित, अम्, n. showing affec-
tion in the absence of a loved object by various ways
of recalling him to mind, the silent expression of
returned affection, (one of the ten Bhāvas or proper-
ties of women.)
